title: [Tracer] Add CreditBalance model + atomic deduct + sync-on-read
description: End-to-end tracer bullet: add Prisma model, implement atomic deduction helper, refactor getCreditsBalance to sync-on-read with min(local, polar). Validates the full architecture before expanding.
design:
## Context
First vertical slice touching DB schema, service layer, and Polar sync logic. Proves the core pattern works before expanding to webhooks, hasCredits, assertHasCredits.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CreditBalance model in schema.prisma: userId (String), meterId (String), balance (Int, default 0), updatedAt (DateTime @updatedAt), @@unique([userId, meterId]), onDelete: Cascade via User relation
- [ ] User model gains `creditBalances CreditBalance[]` relation field
- [ ] Migration runs cleanly (pnpm db:push)
- [ ] getCreditsBalance refactored: after Polar fetch, upserts local row with min(local, polar); returns synced balance
- [ ] If no local row exists, creates one from Polar balance (upsert handles this)
- [ ] If no Polar customer (ResourceNotFound), returns null — no local row created
- [ ] deductCredits(userId, meterId, amount) helper: uses prisma.creditBalance.updateMany with balance: { gte: amount } + { decrement: amount }; returns { success: boolean, newBalance?: number }
- [ ] Concurrent sync + deduction safety: upsert for sync uses atomic Prisma operations (no SELECT then UPDATE); deduction uses updateMany with WHERE balance >= amount
- [ ] Negative Polar balances treated as 0 before storing locally

## Files
- prisma/schema.prisma (modify) — add CreditBalance model with User relation, @@unique([userId, meterId])
- src/features/credits/services/credits.service.ts (modify) — refactor getCreditsBalance to sync-on-read, add deductCredits helper
- src/features/credits/models/credits.model.ts (modify) — add DeductionResult type

## Patterns
- Subscription model in prisma/schema.prisma — User relation with @unique and onDelete: Cascade
- getCreditsBalance existing code — ResourceNotFound catch, logger usage, polarClient.customers.getStateExternal
- Atomic deduction: prisma.creditBalance.updateMany({ where: { userId, meterId, balance: { gte: amount } }, data: { balance: { decrement: amount } } })
- Upsert for sync: prisma.creditBalance.upsert({ where: { userId_meterId: { userId, meterId } }, create: { userId, meterId, balance: syncedBalance }, update: { balance: syncedBalance } })

## Verify
grep -q 'model CreditBalance' prisma/schema.prisma && echo 'model: pass'
grep -q '@@unique' prisma/schema.prisma && echo 'unique: pass'
grep -q 'decrement' src/features/credits/services/credits.service.ts && echo 'atomic: pass'
pnpm db:push

title: Refactor assertHasCredits to deduct locally

- [ ] API unchanged — same signature (userId, meterId, requiredAmount), throws on failure, void on success
- [ ] No longer calls hasCredits internally (replaced by deductCredits flow)
- [ ] Existing error logging preserved

- src/features/credits/services/credits.service.ts (modify) — refactor assertHasCredits body

- Current flow: hasCredits(userId, meterId, requiredAmount) → boolean → throw if false
- New flow: getCreditsBalance(userId, meterId) → null check → deductCredits(userId, meterId, requiredAmount) → throw if !success
- UnauthorizedError from @/lib/errors
- locales.errors.insufficientCredits for error message

title: Handle Polar API errors with local balance fallback
description: When Polar API fails during sync-on-read, fall back to existing local balance. If no local row exists, throw error (fail-safe).
design:
## Context
Edge case: Polar API may be unreachable during sync-on-read in getCreditsBalance. The tracer implements the happy path (Polar responds). This task adds error handling around the Polar call: if local row exists, use it as-is; if not, throw (fail-safe, same as today). Modifies the same function as the tracer but only the error path.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Polar API error (non-ResourceNotFound) + existing local row: return local balance without sync, log warning
- [ ] Polar API error + no local row: throw error (fail-safe, same behavior as today)
- [ ] ResourceNotFound (no Polar customer): return null, no local row created (unchanged from tracer)
- [ ] Log warning with logger.warn when falling back to local balance (include error message, userId, meterId)

## Files
- src/features/credits/services/credits.service.ts (modify) — wrap Polar API call in getCreditsBalance with try/catch, add local fallback logic

## Patterns
- Existing ResourceNotFound catch in getCreditsBalance (currently catches specific error, re-throws others)
- Use logger.warn('Polar API error, using local balance fallback', { userId, meterId, error: error.message })
- Query local: prisma.creditBalance.findUnique({ where: { userId_meterId: { userId, meterId } } })
